posts.text: Does after-care run past 5:30? I work until 5 and the drive takes a while.
I think it ends around 5:30 but the times changed last year, so I'm not sure.
We use the YMCA program a few blocks away instead. It goes until 6.
Same question here. The front office told us to check back in January.
How is the robotics club? Is it worth signing up in sixth grade?
My kid loves it. They meet twice a week and went to a regional competition last spring.
Great club. The coaches are supportive and beginners are welcome.
There is a waitlist some years, so sign up early in August.
Our experience with the IEP process here has been good. The team met with us twice in the first month and actually followed the plan.
Same for us. The resource room teacher is very helpful.
Does the bus route cover the neighborhoods south of Beach Blvd?
After-care here has been great for us. Homework time first, then outside, and pickup is easy.
Agree, the after-care staff are wonderful and it runs late enough for my shift.
Is there a waitlist this year?
What clubs are running this semester?
Chess, yearbook, and a coding club that started in September.
The STEM labs are excellent. Projects every week and the science fair is a big deal here.
Happy with it too. Homework load is reasonable.
Do middle schoolers get to play on a team, or is it intramural only?
There is flag football and volleyball, plus intramurals at lunch.
Is after-care on campus or do they bus kids somewhere else?
The family nights are fun and the teachers reply to emails within a day.
Has anyone used the Florida scholarship here? How long did approval take?
It took about six weeks for us. Apply as early as the window opens.
The music program is wonderful. The spring concert was the best one we've been to.
How does pickup work? The line looked long when we toured.
It moves faster after the first two weeks. Get there by 3:10.
We had long stretches with substitutes last year. Frustrating for our kid and hard to keep up with homework.
Same. Three different teachers in one year and communication was poor.
We were disappointed too. It felt chaotic until spring.
I heard they hired more full-time staff this fall. Has anyone seen a change?
